# Moms on Teaching USA

> Online 1-on-1 tutoring for Indian-American families across the United States, covering Indian Curriculum continuity (CBSE, ICSE, NIOS), US School Support (K-12 Math, Science, English), and Test Prep (SAT, ACT, AP, NEET, JEE), delivered by qualified mother-teachers.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/): Overview of both service tracks and states covered
- [About](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/about.html): Company story and Mother-Teacher philosophy
- [All Services](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/services.html): Indian Curriculum, US School Support, and Test Prep tracks
- [Indian Curriculum](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/services/indian-curriculum.html): CBSE, ICSE, NIOS tuition details
- [US School Support](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/services/us-school-support.html): K-12 Math, Science, English tutoring details
- [Test Prep](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/services/test-prep.html): SAT, ACT, AP, NEET, JEE preparation details
- [New Jersey](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/locations/new-jersey.html): New Jersey-specific service details
- [California](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/locations/california.html): California-specific service details
- [Texas](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/locations/texas.html): Texas-specific service details
- [Illinois](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/locations/illinois.html): Illinois-specific service details
- [New York](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/locations/new-york.html): New York-specific service details
- [Washington](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/locations/washington.html): Washington-specific service details
- [FAQ](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/faq.html): Common questions answered
- [Sitemap](https://usa.momsonteaching.com/sitemap.html): Full list of all pages on the site
